target_codebook: 0 means absence of heart disease; 1 means presence of heart disease.
reference_standard: The source record and one-page codebook do not specify the diagnostic reference standard or stenosis threshold.
prediction_time_limit: The dataset includes noofmajorvessels; Doppala et al. map it to number of major vessels seen by fluoroscopy. Its measurement timing relative to the binary target is undocumented, so it is a high-risk potentially post-diagnostic predictor and is excluded from any early-detection interpretation.
role: Historical development/replication benchmark; it was used by the base study.
eligibility_note: Do not pool this label with the UCI/AngioCAD >50% angiographic endpoint or count it as external validation without a source-level reference-standard definition.
